title: Late Fee Amount on a FlexLine Due Date
content:
On FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the late fee for a due date whose minimum payment is unpaid is calculated as follows.

**Clause.** The late fee is the tier's late fee for the due date whose minimum payment is unpaid, never more than the unpaid part of that minimum payment, rounded to the cent. The unpaid part of the minimum payment is the line's amount past due on the booking date, and the due date charged is the line's next due date.

- *Tier's late fee*: the per-tier figure in the product's late-payment schedule.
- *Unpaid part*: the amount past due that Larkspur's record of the line shows on the day the fee is booked.
- *Due date charged*: the next due date on the same record.
- *Cap and rounding*: the fee is held to no more than the unpaid part, and the result is rounded to the cent; every rounding to the cent here takes an exact half cent to the even cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, a tier late fee of 25.00 USD)

| Unpaid part on the booking date | Tier's late fee | Held to the unpaid part | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60.00 USD | 25.00 | 25.00 is not above 60.00 | 25.00 USD |
| 18.40 USD | 25.00 | 25.00 is above 18.40 | 18.40 USD |
| 25.00 USD | 25.00 | equal | 25.00 USD |
